page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: service category list (#serviceByCategoryList)
wcag_reference: ARIA role compatibility; WCAG mapping requires verification
evidence: Lighthouse flags ul#serviceByCategoryList under Uses ARIA roles only on compatible elements. The element is a UL assigned an incompatible role.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may receive incorrect list semantics or relationships.
recommended_fix: Inspect the rendered DOM and accessibility tree. Remove conflicting ARIA roles where appropriate and verify the native list semantics.
status: Lighthouse finding observed; DOM and remediation require verification

page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: initiatives carousel
evidence: Previously reported Lighthouse finding: links inside carousel slides marked aria-hidden=true, including initiativeLink-463, initiativeLink-1065, initiativeLink-2845 and initiativeLink-2855. The evidence shared in this review does not independently confirm this finding.
user_impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users may encounter focusable links inside content hidden from assistive technology.
recommended_fix: Re-run the relevant audit and inspect keyboard focus and slide behavior. Ensure inactive slides cannot receive focus when hidden.

user_impact: People with motor difficulties and touchscreen users may have difficulty activating small or closely spaced controls.
recommended_fix: Measure target dimensions and spacing, then check applicable WCAG exceptions before concluding non-compliance.
status: Lighthouse finding observed; dimensions and spacing require measurement

page_or_component: National Portal of India - Services page: images and adjacent text
wcag_reference: Potential redundant alternative text; WCAG mapping requires inspection
evidence: Lighthouse Names and labels reports an image-alt-text recommendation concerning redundant text. Specific images and their surrounding links need to be inspected before determining whether their alternative text is redundant.
user_impact: Some screen-reader users may hear duplicate descriptions if an image and adjacent link communicate the same information.
recommended_fix: Inspect each affected image and its surrounding content. Use empty alternative text for decorative or redundant images when appropriate; otherwise provide meaningful alternative text.
status: Lighthouse recommendation observed; affected images require inspection
